label: Level
description: country, state (the 36 states and ABUJA FCT, which the volume lists with the states), lga (Local Government Area; the FCT's six are its Area Councils) or disputed areas (one row in Taraba State, printed with an asterisk and no footnote)

label: State
description: The state an LGA lies in, as its total row prints it; empty for the country and the states

label: Senatorial district
description: The letter (A, B or C) the table prints in its Senatorial District column; 0 on the Taraba disputed-areas row, as printed

label: Senatorial district name
description: The name the legend under each state's table gives the letter, as printed; three legends are cut short in print (Jigawa C, Cross River C, Akwa Ibom C, the last empty)

label: Serial number
description: The table's S/No., as printed; it skips and misprints in Taraba, Benue and Akwa Ibom (see provenance.json)

label: Total
description: Population, both sexes (Both Sexes; Persons on the Oyo page), 2006 census; men plus women

label: Table
description: The table of Priority Table Volume III the row was read from

label: Printed page
description: The page number printed in the volume
